key_insight: Paired DNS and PIV measurements provide a cross-validated dataset of turbulent wakes behind nine bluff-body geometries at Re = 10,000.
engineering_relevance: The dataset supports testing data-driven turbulence closures, reduced-order models, and wake-stability analyses across distinct separation behaviors.
method: Wall-resolved spectral-element DNS for nine shapes and orientations.
Time-resolved planar PIV in the MIT Intelligent Towing Tank.
Matched mean fields and 24-bin lift-referenced phase averages.
evidence_signal: The DNS setup is verified against reference cylinder data at Re = 3900, and DNS and PIV fields are compared at Re = 10,000.
watch_item: Planar PIV and one instantaneous 3D DNS snapshot per body limit evaluation of time-resolved three-dimensional wake dynamics.
paper_title: Turbulent wakes behind nine bluff-body shapes from direct numerical simulation and particle image velocimetry
